_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Acquisition and Sustainment Data Package (ASDP) Requirements for Production Part Approval Process (PPAP)
summary: Defines the aviation and defense process requirements for the Acquisition and Sustainment Data Package (ASDP) Requirements Production Part Approval Process (PPAP), which confirms the production process consistently fulfills customer requirements.
use_relationship:
Defines the aviation and defense process requirements for the Acquisition and Sustainment Data Package (ASDP) Requirements Production Part Approval Process (PPAP). PPAP confirms that the production process has demonstrated the ability to produce products that consistently fulfill customer requirements.
This Data Item Description contains the content and intended use of information for the data deliverable resulting from the work tasks described in the solicitation.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content:
The contractor's Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) data package must adhere to AS9145 Appendix D format, utilizing PDF-based forms for submission. Required data shall be mapped to model-based requirements and formatted as specified in the contract.
When adopting a model-based format, leverage the Department of Defense (DoD) and industry standard architecture frameworks such as the DoD Architecture Framework (DoDAF) or the Unified Profile for DoDAF/MoDAF (UPDM). Employing Systems Modeling Language (SysML) or the Unified Architecture Framework (UAF) is recommended to maximize information transferability, understandability, and reuse.
